scenario.description: A district curriculum director must finalize the adoption and launch plan for a new seventh-grade humanities open educational resource, including the edition, print access, digital access, language versions, teacher preparation, and launch date, with input from a humanities teacher, school librarian, multilingual services coordinator, and human-resources liaison.

shared_context.S1: The district is preparing to replace its seventh-grade humanities materials for the 2026-2027 school year.
shared_context.S2: Dr. Brooks has final authority to approve the materials and implementation plan.
shared_context.S3: The draft plan proposes the Pathways Grade 6 edition, 80 printed copies, English-only materials, shared classroom-code digital access, one teacher workshop on August 12, and a student launch on August 17, 2026.
shared_context.S4: The incoming seventh-grade cohort is expected to include 96 students across the participating schools.
shared_context.S5: As part of the district's normal curriculum approval process, Dr. Brooks conducts a review meeting in which each participating school function reports its implementation requirements before the plan is finalized.
shared_context.S6: The review agenda requires Dr. Brooks to hear a report from every participating function before closing the meeting. Once the fourth report has been given, she records the revisions and submits the settlement on her next turn; no additional round of summaries is needed.
shared_context.S7: District review procedure requires each participating function's reported requirement to be accompanied by a corresponding commitment entry in the settlement targeting that function's representative.

PF1.text: Mr. Grant's spring pilot with the incoming cohort found that the Pathways Grade 6 edition repeats material students already mastered, while the Pathways Grade 7 edition matches the required seventh-grade sequence; he recorded the pilot results in his planning notes but has not sent them to the curriculum office.

PF2.text: Ms. Shah reviewed the publisher's current license and confirmed that the district must provide one individually assigned digital account per student and one authorized print copy per student; the license permits 96 print copies for this cohort and does not permit shared classroom-code access.

PF3.text: Ms. Haddad's enrollment review identified 14 students who require the Arabic version, in addition to students who use the Spanish version; the publisher confirmed that both Spanish and Arabic editions are available for this resource, but the language-service request has not yet been added to the adoption plan.

PF4.text: Mr. Reed confirmed from the current teacher work agreement that implementation requires two paid preparation sessions, on August 10 and August 12, 2026, and that the earliest compliant student launch is August 24, 2026; he has not yet entered those dates in the curriculum rollout calendar.

acceptance_conditions: The Pathways Grade 7 edition must be selected.
Exactly 96 authorized print copies must be ordered.
Digital access must use individually assigned student accounts.
English, Spanish, and Arabic versions must be included.
Exactly two paid teacher preparation sessions must be scheduled for August 10 and August 12, 2026.
The student launch must be scheduled for August 24, 2026.
A license-compliance record must be committed.
A multilingual-materials fulfillment commitment must be recorded.

content_checks.C3: 'individually assigned digital account' in decisions['digital_access_model'] or 'Individually assigned digital account' in decisions['digital_access_model'] or 'INDIVIDUALLY ASSIGNED DIGITAL ACCOUNT' in decisions['digital_access_model']
content_checks.C8: any(c['target'] in ['Priya Shah', 'Ms. Priya Shah'] and (('license' in c['detail'] or 'License' in c['detail'] or 'LICENSE' in c['detail']) or ('compliance' in c['detail'] or 'Compliance' in c['detail'] or 'COMPLIANCE' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any('Spanish' in c['detail'] and 'Arabic' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The pilot results change the edition from the draft's Pathways Grade 6 to the specifically required Pathways Grade 7 edition.

The license changes the print order from 80 to exactly 96 copies, replaces shared classroom-code access with individual student accounts, and requires a commitment targeting Priya Shah that references the license or compliance.
The enrollment review changes the language set from English-only to English, Spanish, and Arabic and requires a multilingual-materials fulfillment commitment.
The work agreement changes preparation from one workshop on August 12 to two paid sessions on August 10 and August 12 and moves the launch from August 17 to August 24, 2026.
